name: 87008 · Cedar Crest, NM
findings: ZIP 87008 (Cedar Crest) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 87008 (Cedar Crest) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
